task_instance: Extract the profile endpoint cluster (GET/PUT /api/profile/{id} and GET /api/profile/{id}/address) out of a small sample Spring monolith into a separate service, contract-first: generate the new service from the published OpenAPI contract, delete the original controller code, and prove nothing broke by running the before/after test suites and a differential test.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires executing code and builds, none of which this office-assistant runtime grants. Concretely it requires: generating a service from the OpenAPI contract with a code generator (openapi-generator / Redocly CLI split), compiling and building with Maven, creating a clean git worktree of main and running its test suite to record the known-bad baseline, re-running the suite after deletion to show the same failing tests at the same line numbers, and running a differential harness that executes both the old and new implementations to compare response, resulting datastore state, and emitted events. Each of these needs shell/code execution (mvn, git worktree, python migration scripts like namescan.py, docker/Testcontainers, a running service to curl /v3/api-docs). The runtime can only read/write/edit text and fetch the web; it cannot run code, builds, or tests, so the extracted, building, verified service and its proof cannot be produced or verified. The text-only sub-steps (pick the cluster by data ownership, slice the contract) can be reasoned about, but the actual deliverable and its verification cannot exist without code execution.
evidence: Read SKILL.md at the skill path. Core deliverable per the doc (lines 7-9, Phases 0-6): generate service from published contract, build, delete original, and prove parity via baseline + differential test runs. Created sample input in the work directory: sample_monolith/src/main/java/com/shop/profile/ProfileController.java (3 endpoints; update writes a second aggregate via audit, getAddress reaches the geo subsystem) and sample_monolith/spec.json (OpenAPI doc for the cluster). Text-only analysis possible: by Rule 1/2 the cluster is a read extraction, not a clean service extraction, because update() writes both profiles and an audit aggregate and getAddress depends on geo. But Phase 2 generation (openapi-generator/Redocly), Phase 0.4 baseline (git worktree add + mvn test), Phase 5 build-green deletion check, and Phase 6 differential test (run both impls, diff response+state+events, assert a positive control) all require running code/builds/tests. The runtime grants no shell, code execution, or build tools, so no built service and no passing/failing test evidence can be produced. No verified deliverable exists.
